pragma solcore;

enum Choice<a> { Selected(a), Other }
enum Box<a> { Box(a) }
trait Mapper<a> { function map(x: a) returns (a); }
trait Maker<a> where a: Mapper { function make(x: a) returns (Choice<a>); }
impl<a> Mapper<Box<a>> where a: Mapper { function map(x: Box<a>) returns (Box<a>) { return x; } }
impl<a> Maker<Box<a>> where a: Mapper {
function make(x: Box<a>) returns (Choice<Box<a>>) { return .Selected(Mapper.map(x)); }
}
